name: api_site_visit_acts_list
_description: GET /api/v1/site-visit-acts - lista actas de visita de obra. Filtros: status (draft/approved/signed), project_id. Ordena visit_date DESC. JOIN projects para name. CTE inline para set_session_context (gotcha B64). webhookId UUID manual (gotcha memoria). alwaysOutputData en Postgres (gotcha B61).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: { code: $json._error, message: $json._details || $json._error, request_id: 'req_' + Date.now() } }) }}

parameters.query: WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok) SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.project_id, a.visit_date, a.audio_url, a.audio_duration_seconds, a.transcript_raw, a.transcript_categorized, a.observations, a.photos, a.acuerdos, a.proxima_visita_prevista, a.pdf_url, a.status, a.approved_at, a.signed_at, a.created_at, p.name AS project_name FROM site_visit_acts a LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctx) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR a.status = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR a.project_id = $5) ORDER BY a.visit_date DESC LIMIT $6::int
